svg.title: Studio image export: raw pixels, PNG Blob, then browser download
svg.desc: Conceptual source flow, not a new API capture or rendered test result. GPU capture draws a frame and returns width and height in backing pixels and a new Uint8Array of RGBA rows from top to bottom. Studio encodes those pixels into an image/png Blob, then requests a named PNG browser download. A 640 by 480 backing canvas has 1228800 raw bytes; compressed PNG file size is separate. Missing capture support returns null and shows a message. Readback or encoding rejection is an error, not a null image. Still export does not pause playback or attach a time or document revision, and has no STL-style preparation cancel or stale-design guard.

g.text: Pixels are not a PNG file
Pause playback and choose the view before exporting a still.
Not a raw capture API side effect
Backing pixels, not CSS size or model mm: 640 × 480 × 4 = 1,228,800 raw bytes.
This calculation does not predict the compressed PNG size.
No capture support → null + Studio message. Readback/encoding rejection → error.
No automatic pause, time/revision stamp, or STL-style cancel/stale check.
Keep the editable model and capture context separately.
Conceptual source flow · not a new API result, renderer test or physical validation
